title: The Traveling Merchant Profit Surge
statement:
A traveling merchant records the daily net profit or loss over N consecutive trading days. The merchant wants to find the maximum possible profit earned in any contiguous sequence of days (at least one day must be chosen).

Given an array of integers representing daily net changes, find the maximum contiguous subarray sum.
inputFormat:
First line: Integer N.
Second line: N space-separated integers.
outputFormat: Print a single integer: maximum subarray sum.

sampleCases.explanation: Single element [-1] gives the maximum sum.
